title: DnD (2nd session)
description: Venturing into the dense forest of Evergreen Hollow, the party stumbled upon a small village where they sought respite at the local tavern.
There, they met the tavern owner, Griswold Ironwood, a friendly but rugged lumberjack.
Intrigued by strange noises and reports of unusual occurrences in the forest, the party spoke with Griswold about what had been happening in the area.
Griswold shared his concerns and spoke of his missing brother, Malachi, a secretive wizard rumored to have been dabbling in dark magic.
Following these clues deeper into Evergreen Hollow, the party discovered forgotten ruins and whispers of a long-lost group of ancient heroes and the power they once possessed.
With these revelations, the party's destiny began to unfold as they prepared to face the challenges ahead and uncover the ancient secrets waiting in the shadows.

title: Gone with Gold
description: The party's daring gambit begins as corruption tightens its grip on the grand city of Valeria.
With whispers of rebellion spreading through the streets and dangerous secrets swirling beneath the surface, the heroes find themselves standing at a crossroads.

They must choose their path: infiltrate the opulent halls of the King's Palace, slipping past guards and avoiding capture in an audacious attempt to seize a fortune in gold, or descend into the treacherous depths of the Tomb of Shadows.
Within the tomb, unknown dangers and ancient forces wait for those bold enough to step near.
The fate of their daring heist or harrowing expedition hangs in the balance as the party prepares to face whatever perils lie ahead.

title: The Uprising
description: Inside the long-awaited Palace Vault, the party is ambushed by a deadly assassin shortly after their encounter with the malicious Malachi.
With only five minutes granted by the ruthless King Mortannis, they must race against time to uncover and steal the vault's hidden treasures.
At the same time, their companions raid the palace in an attempt to abduct the marshal, knowing that failure will mean imminent execution.
The outcome of both daring operations will shape the course of their journey as the party makes its mark on the kingdom of Valeria.
The party loots roughly 300 pounds of gold, worth approximately 25,000 gold pieces.
They also recover around 20 pounds of explosives, including bombs and powder kegs.

title: Flames of Fury
description: After successfully infiltrating the Coven of Eternal Night's stronghold within the Tomb of Shadows, the party emerges victorious with the stolen Arcane Crown.
Prince Lucius reveals that this ancient artifact holds enough power to overthrow the reign of his father, the powerful King Mortannis.
Now faced with a moral dilemma, the party must decide whether to support the prince's cause for justice or succumb to the temptations of power and eliminate the prince as a threat.
The fate of the kingdom now rests upon their monumental decision, one that will determine whether Valeria rises to a new glory or collapses into ruin.
The party initiates a raid into the royal palace.

title: Battle for the Throne
description: Within the rotten walls of Valeria, the party takes command of the rebellion, guided by Prince Lucius, fighting alongside Ragnar, and empowered by the Arcane Crown.
Together they storm the Pristine Palace, pushing through its defenses until they finally confront the corrupted King Mortannis.
United with the rebellious forces of the city, the party attempts to break the king's malevolent corruption and restore peace to the Kingdom of Valeria.
The decision made during this decisive confrontation will shape the future of Valeria for generations to come.
Will they succeed in breaking the darkness that grips the king and restore peace and harmony to the realm, or will the shadows prevail and consume the kingdom entirely?

title: Into the Shadowfell
description: As the party steps into a mysterious, dark, and gloomy realm, an unsettling aura surrounds them.
In the distance, their eyes are drawn to a foreboding floating island that seems to beckon them toward exploration.
Eager to unveil its secrets, the adventurers begin their journey, but they must tread carefully in this unfamiliar and dangerous land.
Haunting shadows loom around them and eerie whispers drift through the air, hinting at the many lurking dangers that could threaten their very existence.
Their quest for knowledge in this shadowy domain will test their courage and unity as they confront the unknown and uncover the mysteries of the island.

title: Darkness Revealed
description: Returning to the town of Valeria, the party's triumph over Vespera's powerful ally echoes across the shattered floating island, now severed from the Shadowfell's grip.
Whispers soon spread of an awakened dragon in Emberhold, but before the party can pursue answers, the night erupts into chaos as familiar vampiric bat-like creatures launch a frenzied assault.

Amid the turmoil, several mysteries begin to intertwine—the origins of these creatures, the truth behind the enigmatic dragon of Emberhold, and the beckoning secrets hidden within Hominod's arcane library.
These unanswered questions burn within the party, promising discoveries that may soon quench their thirst for the truth.

title: Scorching Strength
description: After defeating the vampiric bat-like creatures, the party soon faced new trouble when one of the surviving monsters attempted to abduct Zeldris and drag him toward a mysterious desert temple.
Zeldris managed to escape the creature's grasp and fled into a dangerous cave infested with deadly scorpions, where he hid while the rest of the party searched for him.
Determined to rescue their ally, the party quickly assembled a Valerian caravan and set out across the scorching Searing Sands.
Their journey took a disastrous turn when they encountered a colossal white wyrm trail and a violent sandstorm that destroyed their caravan entirely.
After a perilous journey on foot through the unforgiving desert, the party finally rescued Zeldris and discovered a map hinting at a powerful artifact hidden somewhere within Emberhold.
Continuing their travels south, they arrived at the small desert village of Sunhaven, where the snake-like inhabitants who guarded the dragon Emberax were slain during the confrontation.
After taking control of the settlement, the party renamed the village "The Citadel of Dragon Slaying and Shenanigans."
Although the fortress now lies under their control, its location near Emberhold and the harsh edge of the Searing Sands means it may never truly be safe.
With their new stronghold established, the party begins preparing the citadel for the battles that will surely come.

title: The Dragon Slayers
description: After diligently upgrading their desert base, now known as "The Citadel of Dragon Slaying and Shenanigans," the party set their sights on the heart of Emberhold, the dreaded lair of the dragon Emberax.

Armed with Bjorn and Finn's newly constructed tank, Zyvan and Zeldris's invisible net, and a series of emergency hiding tunnels carved into the iron mine, the party believed themselves fully prepared.
Within Emberhold, Finn managed to slip away with a red dragon egg while the party gathered Emberax's rare and valuable kush herbs.
Their success quickly turned dangerous when Zeldris snatched a mysterious ring from the edge of a volcanic pit, triggering a violent eruption that awakened the slumbering dragon Emberax.
To make matters worse, familiar enemies from the Coven now block the only escape at the entrance to Emberhold.
What began as a daring heist now threatens to become a fiery disaster, as Emberax's wrath looms over the party and the lives of everyone trapped within the cavern.

title: The Battle of Valeria
description: With the dragon finally slain and their desert fortress fully fortified, the party stands stronger than ever before.
Soon after their victory, the newly crowned King Lucius approaches them with a desperate plea for aid.
During their absence, the Kingdom of Valeria has fallen under the control of the sinister Coven of Eternal Night.
Knowing that Malachi is responsible for the kingdom's downfall, the party prepares to return to Valeria once more.
There, they will face Malachi in one final climactic battle that will decide the fate of the kingdom.

title: Whispers of the Past, Shadows of the Present
description: In a climactic battle, the party valiantly defeated the malevolent Malachi, crushing the grasp of his dark influence that had plagued the realm.
Soon after, they thwarted Vespera's mysterious spell, preventing its potential destructive force from being unleashed upon the land.
However, a desperate and vengeful Vespera conjured a powerful magical vortex, immediately engulfing Finn and Zarathustra.
In a moment of solidarity and without hesitation, the remaining members of the party leaped into the vortex.
Their perception of reality twisted and contorted in what seemed like mere heartbeats as they were whisked away to an eerily familiar realm.

title: The Temples of Sorrow
description: Having persevered through the treacherous depths of the Shadowfell, the party now stands at the entrance of the daunting Temple of Sorrows.
Their path to this point has been riddled with relentless battles against an array of dark creatures that haunt this realm, each encounter testing their mettle.
Ragnar, their loyal companion, now bears the weight of 39 additional years.
It is clear that the corruption of the realm is not a fortunate place to live.
Undeterred by the terrors they have faced, the party's resolve remains firm as they prepare to enter the temple.
They are driven by the unwavering hope of finding a portal within its depths that could lead them back to the material plane and reunite them with their missing friend, Finnigan Fairweather.

title: The Tragedy of Griswold
description: The party, divided in approach, navigated the perilous depths of the Temple of Sorrows.

Ic's finesse guided their progress through intricate passages, while Bjorn's brute strength inadvertently triggered a catastrophic collapse, bringing the ancient structure tumbling down in a deafening cacophony.
Amid this chaos, Zeldris and Ælendor formed an unexpected bond, inadvertently unleashing an otherworldly entity onto the material plane.
Escaping the temple's destruction, the party sought refuge at the newly innovated Citadel.
They were quickly greeted by Finn's aged arrival as he swooped in on the albino dragon, Princess Steve.
Their reunion was short-lived as Griswold's sudden demise left the party stunned when he exploded, coating the area in green blood.
Amidst the wreckage, a torn map with cryptic 'X's around Aerthos emerges as their sole clue.
It may be the key to unraveling the tragic events surrounding Griswold's untimely end.

title: Ascendancy
description: As the party narrows ever closer to the floating island called Aerthos, they are stopped as a large bridge stands in their path.
Could this bridge mark the defeat of our heroes?
What awaits our heroes in Aerthos?
Find out next time... on D, and, D.

title: Into to the Arctic Abyss
description: Embarking through a mystical portal atop a colossal bridge, the party entered Aerthos.
Confronted with trials, they emerged triumphant and earned passage.
Amidst dragon statues and ancient ruins, they ascended into the heights of Aerthos.
There they encountered elemental guardians—Tesla, Vexus, Glacius, and Azar—and delved deeper into the island's mysteries.
Unveiling the secrets of a hidden portal, they discovered the Order of Ancients and a sealed gate promising immense wealth and power.
Returning through the passage, they emerged into a vast ice-laden cavern.
Confronted by a terrifying ice hydra, the party battled fiercely and emerged victorious.
Pressing onward into the mountains, they traversed the towering frozen peaks.
There they discovered an abandoned village of frozen automatons, silent and still, yet clearly holding untold secrets.
With curiosity ablaze, the party forged ahead, determined to unravel the mysteries hidden within.

title: Friend or Foe?
description: In the last session, the party attempted to hatch a cold dragon egg but ultimately failed.
During this time, their companions Finnegan Fairweather and Björn Asulf departed on separate paths.
Finnegan flew off into the sunset with Princess Steve, while Björn stayed behind to revive a frozen settlement.
Undeterred by their losses, the remaining adventurers explored Talon Crest Peak.
There they encountered a desolate village and discovered a chest hinting at forgotten treasures.
Near a lightning dragon egg, the party was ambushed but quickly adapted to the danger.
Through clever teamwork, Zeldris transformed Zarathustra into a roc, allowing the party to defeat the dragon.
After claiming the dragon egg and meeting the mysterious Zichard Morty, they continued their journey through the snow.
Braving a violent storm, they eventually took shelter in a cave.
Inside, they encountered three mysterious figures whose intentions remain unknown.

title: A New Connection
description: Seeking refuge from the cold blizzard, the party entered a small ice tunnel.
Inside, they encountered two mercenaries known as Silencer and Grim.
Alongside the mercenaries, they also met a mysterious prisoner named Zarnak.
Combat quickly erupted as the party fought to free the captive.
Zyvan performed expert crawling maneuvers, Zeldris unleashed chaotic dancing magic, and Zarathustra delivered the final decisive blow.
With the mercenaries defeated, Zarnak the prisoner was finally freed.
The fallen mercenaries were soon repurposed as fuel for a warm campfire, allowing the party to rest.
Now joined by their new ally Zarnak, the party was offered powerful connections and equipment if they agreed to follow him into the Underdark.
However, with only a week remaining to locate the tower in the ice lake, the party must decide their next course of action.
They must also determine whether their new ally is truly someone they can trust.

title: Death of Kilrogg
description: As the party emerges from the tunnel through the Vronti Mountains, they are swiftly led by Zarathustra to his meditation site at the top of the 1000-step staircase.
There, the party faces a true test of skill as they complete a demanding obstacle course.
They scale massive statues and even cross a tightrope high above the ground.
During their time there, they learn of the powerful 'Zen Tree,' a mystical tree with strong restorative properties.
After leaving the meditation site, the party encounters a roadblock when an encampment of orcs blocks their path westward.
Agreeing that the orcs must die for their rudeness, the party launches a brutal assault.
One by one, the orcs fall to arrows, fire, mutilation, and freezing magic.
In the end, the party slays them all, including their undying leader Kilrogg.
With the battle finished, the freed prisoners begin to depart.
Before leaving, they offer the party a gift as a sign of their gratitude.

title: Lizardfolk Troubles
description: As the party emerges from the aftermath of the devastated Orc Camp, they are presented with a strange gift from the freed peasant prisoners.
The gift is a skull with unusual properties, its crystal eye occasionally glowing a deep red.
Following Zarathustra's adventurous promise, the party travels to the town of Port Seal.
There, they quickly discover the devastating effects the Orc Camp had inflicted upon the settlement.
Zeldris and Zyvan work swiftly to heal many of the wounded soldiers scattered throughout the town.
The party informs the town's leader, Thelric, of the orc camp's downfall.
Though initially distrustful of their claims, Thelric eventually allows the party a place to stay for the night.
Soon after, Bjorn arrives in spectacular fashion with his massive tank, leaving a trail of destruction behind him.
The following morning, the party awakens to find the nearby lizardfolk have grown aggressive.
With the intimidating presence of Bjorn's tank and promises of freedom, the situation is eventually calmed.
Now, adventure awaits.

title: The Future of Port Seal
description: [INSERT CRAZY AWESOME RECAP + SPOILERS HERE]

title: Expect the Unexpected
description: As the party set out toward the Haven Mines, a fallen tree and strange pale vapour suddenly blocked their path.
It was an ambush.
Unfortunately for the attackers, the party had the favor of RNG JESUS.
Blessed by the dice gods, the party seemed incapable of rolling anything less than a natural 20.
The ambushers were swiftly and brutally defeated.
During the chaos, Zyvan managed to befriend a treant who now eagerly follows the party in search of sunshine.
Yet many questions remain unanswered.
Why were they ambushed?
Why were people being dragged away?
And perhaps most importantly, why wasn't RNG JESUS on the ambushers' side?
Find out next time, on Dungeons... and... Dragons.

title: Where are we?
description: After meeting Inanala the druid, the party soon realizes her malicious goal of harming Thelric.
She demands that the party bring her Thelric's head.
As Zyvan raises the axe, several attempts are made to save Thelric.
At the final moment, Zyvan brings the axe down beside Thelric's head.
Suddenly, with a loud poof, Thelric vanishes.
Seeing this, Zeldris quickly casts teleport on the group.
Unfortunately, Bjorn is too far away and is left behind.
Zeldris attempts to teleport the group to the Elder Tree, but the spell backfires.
Instead, the party is transported to a mysterious town.
There, they meet Zeldris's father for the very first time.

title: Patrick and the Grand Library
description: After the party's teleport fails, they find themselves in an unfamiliar town.
All except Zeldris, who knows exactly where they are.
They are greeted by Zeldris's father, who welcomes the party and introduces them to Zeldris's brother.
Soon after, the party is warned about the approaching dwarven army.
No one knows exactly when the army will arrive, but it will almost certainly bring battle.
The party then enters the grand library.
Inside, they discover Weedszard, who has taken up the job of guarding the library for a bit of spare coin.
As they explore, they notice several strange occurrences happening throughout the town.
These events eventually lead them to someone named Patrick.
As the party searches through the vast knowledge within the library, many secrets still remain hidden.
What they will uncover next remains a mystery.

title: Lugki's Arena
description: The party continues their battle in Lugki's area.
By now they are around wave 5 where they fight duplicates of themselves.
Zarathustra has an epic showdown vs himself.

title: Final Boss
description: By now they are about to fight the final boss of the area, a massive t-rex.

title: The Dwarves Approach
description: As Zyvan delivers the killing blow to the final monstrous beast in Lugki's arena, the party is infused with a fragment of Lugki's soul.
This grants Zyvan, Zarathustra, and Zeldris the power to cast one Wish spell each, provided they win a coin flip.
Soon after, the party awakens once more in the same burning building where they previously began.
The sun is still rising at the break of dawn, exactly as they had left it.
Not long after, warnings spread throughout the town that the dwarves are approaching.
The town of Hominod prepares itself for an all-out battle.
It is likely that the streets of Hominod will soon be bathed in blood.
The only question is whose.

title: Fall of the Library
description: As the battle for Hominod comes to an end, Felton removes the heart from the grand library
After this, the library begins to collapse, and although the party beat the dwarves, it came at a cost.

title: Rebuilding Hominod
description: After the Battle of Hominod, the party spends most of its time repairing the desctruction.
They also make some very questionable but delicious stew.

title: Bjorn's New Mine
description: The party spends most of the session repairing Hominod and restoring their own abilities.
Bjorn begins the reconstruction of his powerful tank.
Zyvan regrows many of the plants and fallen trees that were destroyed.
Zeldris creates a new pocket demiplane containing copies of everyone.
Zarathustra aids the others, assisting in each of their tasks and missions.
Soon, Hominod will be fully repaired.
After that, the story of the Shadow Merchant Money Gang will finally begin to unfold.

title: Second Orc Camp raid
description: The party destroys another orc encampment.

title: Trial in the Elder Tree
description: The party goes to Port Bush where they are split off from Barreldris and Zarathustra.
The rest go in where they find that they are being portrayed as terrorists in Elandria.
They agree to go to trial in the Elder Tree where they are forced to speak on a truth stand in a magic field.
Near the endo of the trial, a group of drow try to assassinate them, along with Zarnak.
Zarnak surrenders and says that he will bring them to the underdark.
The party splits once more as Zeldris and Zyvan go to the underdark where Bjorn stays to clear their names.

title: Bjorn's Discussions
description: Bjorn speaks on his own to the council of the Elder tree.
Along with other talks, he convinces King Lucius to go with him to Hominod and to Valeria to help prove the innocence of the Shadow Merchant Money Gang.

title: Into the Underdark
description: As Zeldris and Zyvan leave Bjorn behind, they follow Zarnak down the Elder Tree.
Zarnak promises to lead them to Vespera and into the depths of the Underdark.
Yet much mystery surrounds this journey.
Can Zarnak truly be trusted?
Is he really guiding them to the Underdark?
Or are Zeldris and Zyvan unknowingly walking toward their own demise?
These questions will be answered as their travels continue this session.

title: The Lair
description: Zarnak leaves the party out of the elder tree, and to the underdark but first, Zeldris and Zyvan had to make a pit stop at the orc encampment.
There, Zeldris almost dies to the Dust of Sneezing and Choking, but Zyvan miraculously saves his life.
They slaughter all the orcs, and continue on following Zarnak.
They continue exploring and venture down into the underdark.
Down there they find Vespera's lair, and get a glimpse of the torment that Bjorn had also found.

title: Reclaiming Reputation
description: Bjorn finally meets back up with Barreldris and Zarathustra after they got split of during the trial
They seek out to Hominod and then after to Valeria so that they can clear the name of the Shadow Merchant Money Gang

title: Nuclear Arrival into Valeria
description: Bjorn finally meets back up with Barreldris and Zarathustra after they got split of during the trial
They seek out to Hominod and then after to Valeria so that they can clear the name of the Shadow Merchant Money Gang
They also find some disguises along the way.

title: WE'RE SO BACK LFG!!!!🔥🔥🔥
description: All of a sudden... poof! Zeldris and Zyvan teleport back into existence with the rest of the party.
At that very moment, the Valerian Palace begins to crumble down to the floor below.
This chaos unfolds shortly after the Valerian Marshal and Tyrant Thorain of the Dwarven District is blown apart by sixteen explosive rounds from Bjorn's kamikaze attack.
Bjorn miraculously survives the blast thanks to the power of the ring he is wearing.
Unfortunately, Barreldris Part 2 is too close to the explosion and is swiftly incinerated.
With the death of the Dwarven District's leader and the destruction unleashed upon the district officials, a massive power vacuum now exists.
The question for this session is who, if anyone, will rise to claim that power.

title: Bloody Visions
description: After the explosion in the Valerian Palace and nearly mistaking Zarathustra for a doppelganger, Barreldris is discovered reduced to charcoal.
King Lucius is quickly escorted away to the Church for safety.
Bjorn also breaks one of his teeth and replaces it with a tooth taken from Bloodric.
Soon after, the party discovers a trail of blood leading to a deeply concerning magic circle.
With Bloodric at their side, they experience a disturbing vision of a massive blood beacon blazing over Valeria while swarms of Alukah scream across the sky.
Zyvan and Bjorn decide to investigate further and soon uncover that the Elven leader is actually Felton the shapeshifter.
The guard responsible is sent to the Church prison, and the pair receive rewards for uncovering the deception.
They also purchase one hundred bombs and an epic potion.
Meanwhile, Zeldris and Zarathustra visit the magic shop where Zarathustra is caught attempting to shoplift.
Fortunately, they manage to talk their way out of trouble.
Zeldris also requests that Barreldris's items be repaired within eight hours.
This is only the beginning.

title: Approaching Alukah Attack
description: The party reunites and investigates the mysterious blood circle further.
They discover it has formed into a growing pillar that begins piercing through the roof of the building.
In a bold move, the party throws Bloodric into the pillar.
This destabilizes the magic and causes the structure to erupt into a massive blood beacon.
The beacon pierces into the clouds above, corrupting them and causing dark red vapours to rain down over the city.
Both the commoners and Zarathustra inhale the vapours.
Zarathustra remains unaffected, but the commoners and Dragonborn guards become violently aggressive and grow two to four times their normal size.
The party is forced to fight and defeat the corrupted commoners before rushing to secure the Church alongside King Lucius.
To protect him, they give King Lucius a potion of gaseous form and he disappears in a puff of smoke.
The party defeats the remaining Dragonborn warriors guarding the area.
However, several of them manage to escape through the magic shop.
